subject.title: Feature: durable natural-language rule learning + explicit multi-mention reply semantics

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class durable conversational rule-governance layer and cross-channel explicit multi-bot mention semantics, or keep the work split across memory-plugin APIs and channel-specific fixes?
rationale: The request changes persisted memory authority, workspace-file precedence, conflict handling, and channel delivery semantics, so automation cannot choose the product contract safely.

options.title: Keep As Design Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers define rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and channel mention semantics before implementation.

options.title: Split The Work
options.body: Use narrower Feishu issues and PRs for message-loss fixes, and create a separate memory-governance design only if maintainers want the durable rule layer.

options.title: Route Through Plugin/API Design
options.body: Require the durable rule-learning capability to prove it cannot be built through memory/plugin APIs before adding core rule-layer surface.

recommendation.title: Keep As Design Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers define rule authority, storage, conflict precedence, and channel mention semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest current-line and recent-history signal across the memory prompt, memory-core promotion, and Feishu mention paths inspected.
